choices.text: Recommend replacing the part and explain the safety reasons.
Do a careful weld repair with a reinforcing plate and inspect it.
Lay out both options with costs and let the farmer decide.

response.text: A farmer from Hanford brings a disc harrow to your Stockton shop with a cracked frame member. A weld repair is cheaper and done today; a new part is safer but takes a week to arrive, in the middle of field prep.
response.title: Weld it or replace it
